findings.event: Bank Technology & Operations Conference & Showcase (Manhattan, Kansas; published as New York, New York)
findings.summary: nov27-r3 correctly set city Manhattan, region Kansas (ksbankers.com 2027 page: 'February 9-10, 2027 Hilton Garden Inn, Manhattan, KS'), but the bare alias 'manhattan' -> ['New York','New York'] in scripts/lib/places.mjs ignores the region, so events.json publishes it as New York, NY (id ...-new-york). audit-run missed it because Kansas's count netted out with the EDCI add.
findings.recommendation: Leave the raw record as it is. In scripts/lib/places.mjs scope the alias: 'manhattan|new york': ['New York','New York'] (plus 'manhattan|ny' if needed) instead of bare 'manhattan', then rebuild. Expect city Manhattan, region Kansas, id bank-technology-operations-conference-showcase-manhattan. A scan of data/raw found no other record affected.
